title: A size bound gives layered polynomial size
statement: Let $T$ be a function from natural numbers to natural numbers, and let $L$ be a language over Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a finite layered-circuit family using only the standard gate operations and having size at most $T(n)$ at every input length $n$, and if there are natural numbers $a,k$ with $T(n)\leq a(n+1)^k$ for every $n$, then $L$ is recognized by such a layered-circuit family with size at most $a(n+1)^k$ at every input length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
$L$ is a language over Boolean strings
$L$ has a finite layered-circuit family using only the standard gate operations with size at most $T(n)$ at each input length $n$
